geminiPrices.note: gemini-2.5-pro was retired mid-Block-1 (the API returns 404 'no longer available to new users') so the model moved to gemini-3.1-pro-preview, the Pro tier the API itself points at. Prices are the paid-tier standard rates for prompts <= 200k tokens from ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing; that page lists no separate audio input rate for this model, so audio and text input are priced identically — which is what the session-2 placeholder assumed, at the wrong absolute rate. Pinned rather than using the gemini-pro-latest alias so a run stays reproducible.

geminiImagePrices.note: Paid-tier standard rates. Image models bill output per image at a fixed token count per resolution tier, so the per-image figure is the published one rather than a token computation. Batch pricing halves the output rate and is not used: the pipeline generates interactively for a human review step. gemini-2.5-flash-image is listed for completeness only and must not be used anywhere -- ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations gives its shutdown as 2026-10-02, inside this project's build window. Which of the two candidate models wins is Block 4 session 2, decided by eye.
